The primary motivation for proposing bidirectional pre-training is that standard language models are unidirectional (left-to-right), which severely restricts representation power by preventing tokens from incorporating context from both directions simultaneously [1].

### Technical Elaboration & Mechanisms
- **Limitation of Prior Work**: Unidirectional models like OpenAI GPT can only attend to previous tokens, which is sub-optimal for sentence-level and token-level tasks like Question Answering [1].
- **The MLM Solution**: BERT uses Masked LM to condition jointly on left and right context across all layers without letting tokens see themselves [1].
